answer: The wharf counter is kept in haven and karst shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Someone as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1172 identities would post 1551 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
